The DemCare ontology represents several types of data, including:

- Demographic data (e.g., DemographicCharacteristicsRecord, gender, dateOfBirth, educationLevel, laterality, size)
- Experimental data (e.g., ExperimentalRecord, ExperimentalAssessment, AbilityToOrganiseAssessment, ApathyAssessment, CognitiveLoadAssessment, FunctionalAbilityAssessment, GaitAssessment, MemorySelfAppraisalAssessment, StressAssessment, ExperimentalDiagnosisAssessment)
- Measured data (e.g., MeasuredData, CognitiveAbilitiesData, FunctionalAbilitiesData, GaitData, LatencyData, MoodVoiceData, OrganisationEfficiencyData, StressData)
- Sensor data (e.g., Measurement, PhysiologicalMeasurement, HeartRate, SkinConductivity, SkinTemperature, AmbientMeasurement, LightLevel, NoiseLevel)
- Activity and event data (e.g., Activity, AtomicActivity, ComplexActivity, Event, ObjectEvent, SocialInteraction, PhysicalActivity, Sleep, Nap, BedExit, TableExit, FoodAndDrinkConsumption)
- Summary data (e.g., DaySummary, ADLSummary, EatingSummary, ExerciseSummary, MoodSummary, SleepSummary, SocialSummary)
- Problem and result data (e.g., Problem, ADLProblem, MealProblem, SleepProblem, NappingProblem, SocialProblem, MoodProblem, Result)
- Questionnaire and report data (e.g., Questionnaire, MoodQuestionnaire, SleepQuestionnaire, Report)
- Protocol and task data (e.g., Protocol, ProtocolStep, Task, DirectedTask, SemiDirectedTask, DiscussionTask, FreeDiscussionTask, DirectedDiscussionTask)

These data types are represented as classes and properties within the ontology, supporting the modeling of clinical, demographic, experimental, sensor, activity, summary, problem, and protocol/task-related information.
